# debezium_postgres_connector (Resource)

Manages a Debezium PostgreSQL outbox connector on a Kafka Connect cluster. Authenticate the schema-history Kafka client with either `sasl_scram` or `aws_msk_iam` (exactly one is required).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Connector authenticating the schema-history Kafka client with SASL/SCRAM.
resource "debezium_postgres_connector" "sasl_scram_example" {
  name                 = "example-service-event-outbox"
  database_hostname    = "postgres"
  database_user        = "debezium_example_ro"
  database_password    = var.example_database_password
  database_dbname      = "example_db"
  database_server_name = "example-service"
  slot_name            = "example_service_debezium"
  table_include_list   = "public.outbox_events"

  schema_history_kafka_topic             = "example-service-dbhistory"
  schema_history_kafka_bootstrap_servers = "kafka-b1:9096,kafka-b2:9096,kafka-b3:9096"

  outbox_route_topic_replacement = "example.outbox.event.$${routedByValue}"

  # Optional tuning knobs; shown here with non-default values, omit to use the defaults.
  snapshot_mode         = "initial"
  heartbeat_interval_ms = 5000

  sasl_scram = {
    username = "debezium"
    password = var.example_kafka_password
  }
}

# Connector authenticating the schema-history Kafka client with AWS MSK IAM.
resource "debezium_postgres_connector" "aws_msk_iam_example" {
  name                 = "example-other-service-event-outbox"
  database_hostname    = "postgres-other"
  database_user        = "debezium_example_other_ro"
  database_password    = var.example_other_database_password
  database_dbname      = "example_other_db"
  database_server_name = "example-other-service"
  slot_name            = "example_other_service_debezium"
  table_include_list   = "public.outbox_events"

  schema_history_kafka_topic             = "example-other-service-dbhistory"
  schema_history_kafka_bootstrap_servers = "kafka-b1:9096,kafka-b2:9096,kafka-b3:9096"

  outbox_route_topic_replacement = "example-other.outbox.event.$${routedByValue}"

  aws_msk_iam = true

  # Escape hatch: any Kafka Connect/Debezium config key not exposed as an attribute above can be
  # set directly here. Merged in last, so it can also override attribute-derived values.
  extra_config = {
    "publication.name" = "example_other_service_publication"
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `database_dbname` (String) PostgreSQL database name to capture.
- `database_hostname` (String) PostgreSQL server hostname.
- `database_password` (String, Sensitive) PostgreSQL replication user password.
- `database_server_name` (String) Logical name identifying the PostgreSQL server/cluster, used as a topic prefix.
- `database_user` (String) PostgreSQL replication user.
- `name` (String) Name of the connector in Kafka Connect.
- `outbox_route_topic_replacement` (String) Topic name replacement pattern for the outbox event router, e.g. `trunk.outbox.event.${routedByValue}`.
- `schema_history_kafka_bootstrap_servers` (String) Comma-separated Kafka bootstrap servers used by the schema-history client.
- `schema_history_kafka_topic` (String) Kafka topic used to store the database schema history.
- `slot_name` (String) Name of the PostgreSQL logical replication slot.
- `table_include_list` (String) Comma-separated list of `schema.table` regexes to capture, e.g. `public.outbox_events`.

### Optional

- `aws_msk_iam` (Boolean) Authenticate the schema-history Kafka client using AWS MSK IAM. Mutually exclusive with `sasl_scram`.
- `database_port` (Number) PostgreSQL server port. Defaults to `5432`.
- `decimal_handling_mode` (String) How `DECIMAL`/`NUMERIC` columns are represented in change events. One of `precise`, `double`, `string`. Defaults to `precise`.
- `extra_config` (Map of String) Escape hatch for any Kafka Connect/Debezium config key not otherwise exposed as an attribute. Merged in last, so it can override any other attribute's value. Not reconstructed on read/import.
- `heartbeat_interval_ms` (Number) Interval in milliseconds at which the connector sends heartbeat messages. `0` disables heartbeats. Defaults to `0`.
- `max_batch_size` (Number) Maximum size of a batch processed by the connector. Defaults to `32768`.
- `max_queue_size` (Number) Maximum size of the connector's internal change event queue. Defaults to `131072`.
- `message_key_columns` (String) Semicolon-separated list of `schema.table:column1,column2` expressions overriding the message key for specific tables.
- `outbox_route_by_field` (String) Outbox table column used to route events to a topic. Defaults to `queue_scope_type`.
- `outbox_table_field_event_key` (String) Outbox table column used as the outgoing record key. Defaults to `queue_scope_id`.
- `outbox_table_field_event_timestamp` (String) Outbox table column used as the outgoing record timestamp. Defaults to `created_at`.
- `outbox_table_fields_additional_placement` (String) Additional outbox column-to-header/envelope placement mappings.
- `plugin_name` (String) PostgreSQL logical decoding plug-in. Defaults to `pgoutput`.
- `publication_autocreate_mode` (String) How the PostgreSQL publication is created when using `pgoutput`. One of `all_tables`, `disabled`, `filtered`. Defaults to `all_tables`.
- `sasl_scram` (Attributes) Authenticate the schema-history Kafka client with SASL/SCRAM-SHA-512. Mutually exclusive with `aws_msk_iam`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sasl_scram))
- `security_protocol` (String) Security protocol used by the schema-history Kafka client. One of `PLAINTEXT`, `SSL`, `SASL_PLAINTEXT`, `SASL_SSL`. Defaults to `SASL_SSL`.
- `slot_drop_on_stop` (Boolean) Whether to drop the logical replication slot when the connector stops. Defaults to `false`.
- `snapshot_mode` (String) Snapshotting behavior on first startup. One of `always`, `initial`, `never`, `initial_only`, `exported`, `custom`. Defaults to `initial`.
- `tombstones_on_delete` (Boolean) Whether a tombstone event is emitted after a delete event. Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Connector identifier (same value as `name`).
